Awful, you would think souls with guns?! sounds awesome..BUT listen to this experience first. 

when you turn left or right, your character stutters almost like it was not finished, you can see this for yourself in nearly any lets play or walkthrough. It doesn;t look bad on youtube, UNTIL its on your screen, kills immerision about ever 10-15 seconds as the game reminds you your own character wasen't finished with animation it seems. (it isnt present when you AIM down) 

ok I thought. whatever, i can do deal with that reallly annoying, but lets keep going, this is what the level design feels like. 
OK I went left..right..then wait where am I?, Rinse and repeat that statement, because the levels all look exactly the same every step of the way so unless your brain can unravel a maze you will be lost about every 10 seconds. 

ok maybe bad level design, maybe some character jank, but its gotta sound cool right? nope weapon sounds atleast for what i experienced were terrible and soft sounding. like a little bb gun.

Oh and to add it crashed on me 3 times.

1.8 hours of play isnt alot, but its almost 2 hours of self convincing to try and like a title, and the short journey was filled with annoyances, why force yourself to try and like something, shouldnt have to when we have Wo long, lies of P, and The lords of the Fallen with probable Elden Ring DLC on the way. I will gladly wait with the Surge 2 until those come out.

hope this helps.

One of the most underrated games I have ever played. Admittedly it starts slow, monsters are slow to kill and there are certain monsters you need to learn how to take down efficiently, but once you find some proper weapons and upgrade them, (I enjoy using a sniper gun combined with an item that gives 1 bullet back for every kill), it really gets fun.

I thought the game was small, but it's actually very big, so much to explore, so much lore if you're interested, and a cool story to go along with it.

The closest game I know is Remnant: From the Ashes, it's basically an indy soulslike but with guns. I like it a lot, this is all I play these days, and the game only gets better the deeper I get.

Recommended.
